name: close_hauled
description: Stable close-hauled sailing: a uniform 3.5 m/s westerly with the boat heading north-west, 45 degrees off the wind, and the sheet at the setting that measured best in docs/v1/progress/07-handoff.md. R2 does not fire here - the boat settles at about 1.8 m/s with under 7 degrees of heel.
